name: Yunoki Mio
source:
The protagonist who is an active member of the tennis club, as well as the student council president. Mio is a hardworking girl who is very popular with her peers, and she has a graceful personality.

Her parents are doctors and currently working abroad, so she lives together with just [url=/c45157]Shiori[/url], whom she has a close relationship with.
